pre_registered_threshold.rationale: 10pp improvement would bring accuracy from 60% to 70% — approaching buyer-grade. Impedance must identify failure TYPES that pressure cannot distinguish (e.g., fouling vs obstruction).

contradiction_resolution.resolution: The V17 code had a bug: new_modality_found was set to score >= 6, but the actual code computed score = gain × credible where gain=3 (HIGH) and credible=3 (YES) = 9 ≥ 6. So new_modality_found should have been TRUE. The V17 conclusion 'MECHANISM SPACE EXHAUSTED' was WRONG — impedance IS a credible new modality.
contradiction_resolution.V18_test: Tested impedance: combined accuracy = 90.8% vs pressure 56.8% (gain: +34.0pp). MEANINGFUL — impedance adds new information.

part_1_territory_1.verdict: Impedance scoring contradiction RESOLVED. V17 incorrectly said 'exhausted'. V18 tested: combined=90.8% vs pressure=56.8% (gain: +34.0pp). MEANINGFUL — impedance adds new information. Type discrimination: FOULING 44.5% vs 50.5% (gain -6.0pp).

part_2_territory_2.verdict: Recalibrated model (slower degradation) shows: size-selective filter retains antibodies well (conc=0.0X) but fails for small molecules. Multi-mechanism (size-selective + hydrodynamic) retains ALL payload types — combines size-selective advantage for large molecules with hydrodynamic advantage for small molecules. Multi-mechanism is the strongest architecture for payload diversity, but has slightly lower drainage (90% vs 95%).

differentiator.V7_causal_path: Low blood entry probability (0.1) → minimal blood contact → low biochemical activation (0.08) → no coagulation → no thrombus
differentiator.El_Shafei_causal_path: Short residence time (0.05s) → no time for coagulation cascade → no thrombus despite moderate blood contact (0.35 activation)
differentiator.biologically_defensible_differentiator: ROBUSTNESS MARGIN — how much degradation/ perturbation before thrombus appears?
differentiator.test: Gradually degrade each mechanism's key parameter and measure when thrombus first appears:
differentiator.V7_degradation_path: Increase blood_entry_prob from 0.1 toward 1.0 (washout zone fails)
differentiator.El_Shafei_degradation_path: Increase residence_time from 0.05 toward 5.0 (retrograde flow weakens)

part_3_territory_5.verdict: V7 has thrombus onset at 5.4x degradation, but El-Shafei NEVER produces thrombus in the tested range (up to 10x). El-Shafei retrograde flow is MORE robust than V7 flow topology. V7 does NOT have an advantage over El-Shafei in robustness margin.
